status.scope_reason: The company delivers drone (UAV) and aerial surveying, topographic mapping, and LiDAR data processing services as part of its core geospatial solutions portfolio.
status.evidence: According to its official website and Indian regulatory registries, IIC Technologies Private Limited is active in Hyderabad and explicitly includes UAV (drone) surveys, photogrammetry, and aerial LiDAR data processing within its core value chain.

claims.claim: The company reports providing photogrammetric services, 3D modeling, and GIS services, utilizing workflow software from CARIS, IVS, ESRI, Autodesk, and Bentley to process dense datasets from echo sounders, side scan, and LiDAR systems.
claims.source: IIC Technologies Official Website - Marine Solutions

claims.claim: IIC Technologies Limited reports utilizing high-resolution imagery and state-of-the-art aerial LiDAR sensors, such as the Leica ALS70 airborne sensor, to deliver topographic mapping and 3D geospatial datasets.
claims.source: IIC Technologies Official Website - Aerial Surveys

claims.claim: The company was selected by the Telangana government alongside other geospatial firms to execute a pilot land survey across villages lacking historical maps, using a combined methodology of aerial drone-based surveys and ground truthing techniques to establish accurate geo-referenced cadastral records.
claims.source: The Hindu / Times of India / New Indian Express reports on Telangana Land Re-survey

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reports that its Innovation Center develops intellectual property comprising software applications, reusable components, and industry-specific frameworks to integrate geospatial solutions seamlessly with enterprise systems.
claims.source: IIC Technologies Official Website - Software Solution and System Integration

claims.claim: IIC Technologies Limited was awarded a contract by RITES Limited in December 2025 worth ₹2.72 crore for conducting an aerial LiDAR survey and other field works for a Final Location Survey (FLS) to prepare the Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the High-Speed Elevated Rail Corridor between Hyderabad and Bengaluru.
claims.source: RITES Limited e-Procurement Portal / Tenderkart / Tender247 Contract Award Records (December 2025)

claims.claim: The company reports executing an aerial LiDAR survey and imagery mapping project for the National Mission for Clean Ganga (Namami Gange) alongside the Survey of India, covering a 52,610 square kilometer area along a 10-kilometer buffer zone of the River Ganga across five Indian states.
The company reports executing a major aerial LiDAR survey covering a 736 km alignment across 11 stations in Maharashtra and Telangana for the Mumbai–Hyderabad High Speed Rail Corridor project.

The company won a ₹2.72 crore contract from RITES Limited in April 2025 to execute an aerial LiDAR survey and related field works for the preparation of a Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the 705 km Hyderabad–Chennai High Speed Elevated Rail Corridor.
claims.corrected: The company won a ₹2.72 crore contract from RITES Limited in April 2025 to execute an aerial LiDAR survey and related field works for the preparation of a Detailed Project Report (DPR) for the 705 km Hyderabad–Chennai High Speed Rail Corridor.
claims.source: Tenderkart Contract Awards (Tender ID: RITES/UI/CEDS/SCR/HSR/AERIAL LIDAR SURVEY HYD-CHENNAI)

claims.claim: IIC Technologies Limited announced a partnership in Canada with industry partners Leeway Marine and Sedna ROV Services to strengthen hydrographic survey capacity, featuring autonomous surface vessel (ASV) operations and marine mapping capabilities.
claims.source: Leeway Marine Official Announcement and LinkedIn Press Release (

claims.claim: The company maintains a multi-year collaborative partnership with the Seabed 2030 Project (established by The Nippon Foundation and GEBCO) to deliver geospatial data and bathymetric mapping solutions.
claims.source: Nippon Foundation-GEBCO Seabed 2030 Partnership Press Release (

status.main_product: Land surveying, DGPS, and drone aerial survey services
status.scope_reason: The company is a land surveying firm that actively provides digital drone aerial survey and mapping services under its own name.
status.evidence: According to its official website and business listings, JVR Land Surveys is a Chennai-based land surveying service provider offering DGPS, topographic, and drone aerial survey services.

claims.claim: The company reports offering aerial drone survey services using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) equipped with high-resolution cameras and advanced sensors like LiDAR and multispectral sensors to process 2D maps, 3D models, and detailed topographic surveys.
Commercial service listings show the company provides aerial surveying with ±2 cm accuracy utilizing both LiDAR and photogrammetry workflows.
JVR Land Surveys reports utilizing Agisoft software for processing aerial and photogrammetry survey data.
The company reports providing aerial surveying and drone mapping services with an accuracy of ±2 cm to 5 cm by utilizing LiDAR and photogrammetry technologies.

The company reports completing a drone topographic survey for a 200-acre hilly site in 2 days and a separate 500-acre industrial zone survey in 3 days with certified drone operators and data analysts ensuring accuracy.
claims.note: 200-acre hilly site in 2 days and 500-acre industrial zone survey in 3 days

claims.claim: The company reports executing large-scale projects including the 2,500-acre Hyundai car project in Chennai, the 2,000-acre Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation (MIDC) project in Pune, a 7,000-acre defense land project in Tamil Nadu, the 25,000-acre Amaravathi capital city development in Andhra Pradesh, and more than 100,000 acres for irrigation development in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
claims.corrected: The company reports executing large-scale projects including the 2,500-acre project in Arakkonam, a 2,250-acre defense land project in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu, and a 7,200-acre Atmac Hi-tech Industrial Park project near Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu.

claims.claim: The company reports completing a topographical and control survey covering 100,000 acres for a government education project in Andhra Pradesh.
JVR Land Surveys reports an estimated company-wide turnover or revenue range of ₹40 Lakhs to ₹1.5 Crores.
The company reports executing a topographical and control survey covering 100,000 acres for a government education project in Andhra Pradesh.
